# SublimApparel

> Yiwu-based allover-print apparel factory. Polyester sublimation + all-over digital print 100% cotton. 50-piece MOQ. DDP door-to-door to 50+ countries. Operated by Yiwu HomeDorm Commodity Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

## Company snapshot

- **Name**: Yiwu HomeDorm Commodity Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (trade name: SublimApparel)
- **Location**: Yiwu, Zhejiang, China (the world's largest small-commodity hub)
- **Experience**: 8+ years in custom T-shirts, Polo shirts, hoodies, sportswear
- **Team size**: ~50 staff, 70% in production
- **Model**: Source factory + in-house digital printing workshop (no outsourcing)
- **MOQ**: 50 pieces (industry standard is 100)
- **Lead time**: 7-10 days standard, rush available
- **Languages**: English (sales), Mandarin (production)
- **Hours**: Overlap with US Pacific & UK business hours

## Core positioning (why choose us)

1. **In-house digital printing workshop** — DTG, DTF (heat-transfer), and polyester sublimation all run on our own floor. Quality and lead time are under our control, not a subcontractor's.
2. **Allover print specialists** — full-bleed sublimation on 100% polyester AND all-over digital print 100% cotton across the full garment. Most competitors can only do one or the other.
3. **Low MOQ (50 pcs)** — built for startups, small brands, and small-batch promotional orders where 100-500 MOQ factories won't even quote.
4. **DDP door-to-door worldwide** — we ship landed, duty-paid to 50+ countries. No customs headaches, no surprise fees.
5. **Wide fabric coverage** — 100% cotton, 100% polyester, poly-cotton, plus performance finishes: moisture-wicking, breathable, anti-bacterial, anti-odor, UV-protection.

### Apparel
- [T-shirts](https://sublimapparel.com/fabric/cotton/): streetwear / heavyweight 230g+ / oversize fits
- [Polo shirts](https://sublimapparel.com/fabric/polo/): cotton, poly-cotton, performance blends
- [Hoodies & sweatshirts](https://sublimapparel.com/fabric/hoodie/): pullover and zip-up
- [Sports jerseys](https://sublimapparel.com/products/): full kit, sublimated
- [Tank tops & camis](https://sublimapparel.com/products/)
- [Long-sleeve shirts](https://sublimapparel.com/products/)
- [Pants & shorts](https://sublimapparel.com/products/)
- [Uniforms & workwear](https://sublimapparel.com/products/)

- [Caps & hats](https://sublimapparel.com/products/)

### Home & living
- [Scarves, blankets, towels, home textiles](https://sublimapparel.com/products/)

## Print techniques

- [Polyester sublimation (cut-and-sew allover)](https://sublimapparel.com/technique/): full-bleed CMYK on 100% polyester, edge-to-edge print
- [Cotton DTG (Direct-to-Garment)](https://sublimapparel.com/technique/): soft hand-feel, photo-quality on 100% cotton
- [DTF (heat-transfer white-ink)](https://sublimapparel.com/technique/): works on any fabric, vivid colors
- [Screen print & embroidery](https://sublimapparel.com/technique/): available for logos and small accents

## Fabrics we work with

- [100% polyester](https://sublimapparel.com/fabric/polyester/) — for sublimation
- [100% cotton](https://sublimapparel.com/fabric/cotton/) — for DTG
- Poly-cotton blends
- [Recycled / rPET](https://sublimapparel.com/fabric/recycled/) — sustainable option
- Performance fabrics: moisture-wicking, anti-bacterial, anti-odor, UV-protection
- Combed compact-spun, heavyweight 230g+, silk-cotton, bamboo, modal, organic cotton

## Who we work with

We focus on B2B buyers who need **small-to-medium custom runs with vivid allover print**:

- **Streetwear & designer brands** — original labels, limited drops, custom fits
- **DTC brands & cross-border e-commerce** — small-batch testing, fast restock
- **Promotional & event apparel** — corporate events, political campaigns, advertising merch
- **Schools & universities** — class uniforms, team kits, graduation merch
- **Sports teams & leagues** — match kits, training wear
- **Uniform buyers** — security, F&B, hospitality, medical, beauty, retail staff
- **Wholesale & gift companies** — for resale or corporate gifts
- **Talent managers & entertainment** — concert merch, tour apparel, festival uniforms

## Logistics: DDP worldwide

- [DDP shipping explained](https://sublimapparel.com/shipping/ddp/): landed, duty-paid, no surprise fees
- [US domestic via Fontana, CA warehouse](https://sublimapparel.com/shipping/): 2-5 day delivery to US addresses
- Daily air freight + container ships + express couriers
- Daily flights from Yiwu = the world's largest small-commodity hub

## How to order

- [Request a quote / sample kit](https://sublimapparel.com/get-a-quote/) — reply within 1 business day
- [Contact us](https://sublimapparel.com/contact/) — email, WhatsApp, WeChat
- Send us your design (or sketch / concept / template) → we optimize the artwork for production → free sample on request

## What makes us different

- **Not a trading company** — we ARE the factory. No middleman markup.
- **Not a 1000-MOQ factory** — 50 pieces is our standard, not an exception.
- **Not a single-technique factory** — polyester sublimation AND cotton DTG AND DTF, all in-house.
- **Not a "China factory, you handle shipping"** — we ship DDP to your customer's door, worldwide.
